editorNote: Crypto and China tech sold off while gold held below $4,000 ahead of US inflation data; Alibaba's earnings are six days away. Most items here rest on headlines from outlets we could not open in full.

stories.headline: Bitcoin slips below $70,000 as higher yields weigh on crypto
stories.summary: Bloomberg, WSJ and Barron's headlines all have bitcoin under $70,000 on Friday; Bloomberg attributes the slide to higher yields, and Barron's says Robinhood, Coinbase and other crypto stocks followed it down.
stories.whyItMatters: The headlines point to a broader risk-off tone reaching crypto-linked equities as well as the token itself.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Slips Below $70,000 as Higher Yields Weigh on Crypto - Bloomberg.com
Bitcoin Holds Below $70,000 as Risk-Off Mood Pressures Crypto - WSJ
Bitcoin Slumps Below $70,000. Robinhood, Coinbase, and Other Crypto Stocks Follow It Down. - Barron's

stories.headline: Gold rebounds but is headed for a weekly fall ahead of US inflation data
stories.summary: Reuters reports gold bounced but remains on course for a weekly decline before US inflation figures; a FOREX.com note describes XAU/USD as trading below $4,000.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold, a watchlist holding, enters the inflation release having lost ground on the week.

sourceLinks.title: Gold rebounds but heads for weekly fall before US inflation data - Reuters
Gold outlook: seasonal tailwind offers hope with XAU/USD below $4,000 - FOREX.com

stories.headline: Alibaba hits a new annual low at $94.34 as Nvidia fallout and tighter-regulation fears hit China stocks
stories.summary: 24/7 Wall St. reports Alibaba dropped to a new annual low of $94.34. Barron's says Nvidia fallout is hitting Alibaba and other China stocks as tighter regulation looks likely, and Simply Wall St. cites fresh US AI chip curbs affecting its cloud plans.
stories.whyItMatters: The shares are at their lowest level of the year, with the stated drivers being regulatory and chip-access concerns.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba Drops to a New Annual Low at $94.34 - 24/7 Wall St.
Nvidia Fallout Hits Alibaba and Other China Stocks as Tighter Regulation Looks Likely - Barron's
Alibaba (NYSE:BABA) Faces Fresh US AI Chip Curbs That Hit Cloud Plans - Simply Wall St

stories.headline: Alibaba shares may move 5.7% on its Nov. 19 earnings release, Investing.com says
stories.summary: Investing.com's headline says Alibaba shares may move 5.7% on the Nov. 19 earnings release.
stories.whyItMatters: Options-implied moves frame the size of reaction the market is pricing for the report.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba shares may move 5.7% on Nov. 19 earnings release - Investing.com

stories.headline: Alphabet raises $3.8 billion in its first Hong Kong and Singapore dollar bonds
stories.summary: Reuters reports Alphabet raised $3.8 billion in its first bonds denominated in Hong Kong and Singapore dollars.
stories.whyItMatters: It extends Alphabet's run of non-US-dollar debt offerings, which previous editions noted in euro form.

sourceLinks.title: Alphabet raises $3.8 billion in first Hong Kong, Singapore dollar bonds - Reuters

stories.headline: Rocket Lab: a $150M loan commitment, with revenue up 73% and a Q4 loss outlook
stories.summary: TradingView's key-facts summary lists a $150 million loan commitment for Rocket Lab alongside 73% revenue growth and an outlook for a Q4 loss.
stories.whyItMatters: The loan commitment is a financing disclosure added to the earnings picture covered earlier this week.

sourceLinks.title: Key facts: Rocket Lab $150M loan commitment; revenue up 73%, Q4 loss outlook - TradingView

stories.headline: Google picks AMD EPYC for its next-generation TPUs, Barchart reports
stories.summary: Barchart's piece, framed as how to play AMD, says Google has picked AMD's EPYC processors for its next-generation TPUs.
stories.whyItMatters: It names a CPU supplier for Alphabet's in-house AI accelerators, per Barchart.
